name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Customer Success Associate role. Onboarding customers, training their teams, and watching account health closely enough to catch a problem early is the work I'm strongest at. At Wix I onboarded 25+ clients a month, and at Birdeye I retained all but one of 15 to 20 reseller partners by monitoring utilization data and stepping in on adoption gaps.

Your posting asks for advanced client management with automation flows, triggers, and monitoring, and that's what I build. I've built 20+ automated workflows that tag and route customers and trigger follow-up when someone misses a step or goes quiet, and I build dashboards in Power BI and Excel and present the results. At Accelo I worked with architecture and engineering firms, so I know how construction-adjacent teams think about schedules and handoffs.
I have more experience than the role requires, and I'm applying because I want to do this work well for a company that builds real things. I'd welcome a conversation.
